scope: R7 responsive, interactive design proposal. Existing hosted R6 source extended with workspace tabs, local split trees, independent conversation tabs and browser auxiliary windows. R6 remains accessible under /r6/.

capture_basis.context: Real production chat component rendered using Storybook fixtures, previously captured and reviewed again beside R7. Installed app screenshot was a CLI tab; no claim of real provider-backed structured chat capture.
capture_basis.review: Desktop columns, 1+2, light theme, a narrow desktop pane, a real auxiliary window and phone captures inspected. Mobile rows changed to focused-pane navigation after the capture/test showed too little reading space. Repetitive layout toast removed so it does not obscure the composer. Narrow queue controls compacted.

decisions: A workspace tab remembers its own split tree; each split leaf owns conversation tabs and an input target.
Horizontal, vertical, 1+2, nested split, divider resizing and focus mode are interactive.
Tab drag moves one conversation; the grip moves a group. Center drops merge tabs, edge drops split. Menus and keyboard controls cover the same operations.
A browser auxiliary window can split locally without taking other conversations from the main window. It returns conversations via a button or window close.
Phone and undersized containers show one pane with a switcher while retaining the original split tree.
Desktop Enter semantics depend on input device context, not a narrow pane width. Mobile Enter inserts a newline.

validation.accessibility: axe WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA, including embedded frames: zero violations across desktop columns, desktop 1+2, light and phone views. This is automated coverage, not a full manual accessibility certification.
validation.behaviors: Stable iframe identity across layouts; draft, attachment metadata, reply, queue and caret preservation; reload persistence; real popup transfer including scroll and approval state; local auxiliary split ownership; return and close recovery; popup blocking; tab and group drag; keyboard menus and dividers; desktop vs touch Enter; secondary-pane approval and inspector; global new conversation shortcut.
validation.hosted_smoke: Published R7 returned HTTP 200. Verified three-pane layout plus real auxiliary window local split and return, with no page errors. The platform-injected iframe is excluded from the app-frame readiness condition.

project_contract: DESIGN.md, docs/ux/frontend-design.md and production Storybook/component contracts were read before design. Runtime theme sources retain ownership. Existing root machine-readable design validation limitations are recorded in the R6 review; no project document adoption or baseline replacement was performed.
boundaries: All AI messages, progress, command approval and file diffs are fixtures. No provider, daemon, filesystem or Git actions are performed by the prototype.

Window moves serialize fixture UI state; native Electron adoption must retain the existing Dockview panel instance and provider/PTY lifecycle. The browser prototype does not prove native session continuity.
OS-outside dragging uses an explicit popup-opening button because of browser user-activation restrictions.
Attachment bytes are not persisted or uploaded, only filename and size metadata.
No Android device keyboard validation or product release certification.
